title: Density expectation as convolution at zero
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\phi$ be a nonnegative function on the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ whose uniform expectation is $1$, and let $g: \mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{R}$. Then the expectation of $g$ with respect to the density $\phi$ equals the convolution of $\phi$ and $g$ evaluated at the zero vector.
